item.title: [+1] GST officials begin talks ahead of October 7 Council meeting, first in about a year, on process reforms
item.description:
Officer-level meetings run October 5–6 before the 57th GST Council on October 7. The agenda covers input tax credit, inverted-duty refunds, e-invoicing and registration; no rate changes are expected. New.

Capital goods & infra: mild tailwind (+1) — Quicker inverted-duty refunds

Why it matters: Faster refunds and simpler credit rules free working capital for manufacturers and traders, a modest support for capital goods, consumer goods and small businesses.

Market gauges: Growth outlook +1

Confidence: low · horizon: months

item.title: [−1] India–US trade talks still snag on Russian oil as new US law allows tariffs of up to 100%
item.description:
February's interim deal cut US tariffs on Indian goods to 18% in return for halting Russian oil purchases. A US law passed in September authorises tariffs of up to 100% on big buyers of Russian energy. Ongoing risk.

Capital goods & infra: mild headwind (−1) — Engineering exports exposed to tariffs

Why it matters: Any lapse on Russian oil risks steep US tariffs on Indian exports, while giving up discounted crude raises the import bill; the uncertainty weighs on exporters and foreign investors.

Market gauges: Growth outlook −1, Fiscal & trade balance −1

Confidence: low · horizon: months
